data.notes: As of May 2026, September’s confirmed music calendar around Hvar is still sparse, with the strongest verified listing a local folklore song-and-dance showcase in Jelsa on Hvar Island.

events.title: Terranza After Beach Program
events.summary: Carpe Diem Beach’s open-air sunset after-beach programme runs daily from 4pm to midnight with free entry, making it the clearest confirmed September dance-oriented beach programme on Hvar before the night programme situation is resolved.

events.title: Hula Hula Beach Party
events.summary: A bookable afternoon-to-sunset Hula Hula table-party format with a DJ-led party window from 5pm to 10pm, listed as available through the end of September.

events.title: Carpe Diem Bar Night Program
events.summary: Carpe Diem Bar’s 2026 night programme lists DJs, artists and shows every night from 10pm to 2am on the Hvar town terrace, a dependable local warm-up/late-evening option rather than a touring-brand club night.

events.title: Island Folklore Groups on Show
events.summary: A cultural gathering of folklore ensembles from Croatian islands, presenting traditional heritage through dance, song, and costumes. The event is organized by KUD Jelsa and the Jelsa Municipality Tourist Board, with a listed start time of 21:00.
